description: Recolour every built-in piece by role in one step with a style palette (list_palettes): upholstery, timber, stone, metal, lamp shades and so on each take the palette's finish; screens, bulbs, plants, books, people and cars keep theirs, as do asset-library models. walls and floors also paint every room's walls and floor slab. The project keeps the palette, so pieces placed afterwards come in it. One undo step. Repaint single surfaces afterwards with paint_surface.

floors.description: Also paint every room's floor (default false)

walls.description: Also paint every room's walls (default false)

name: apply_palette
title: Apply a style palette
